weight_total_t.source: brief: total weight around 120 t for the four-car RABe 523

capacity_total.note: in the 160-220 band the brief allows; carried as total passengers

power_per_cab_car_kw.note: FLIRT traction is on the two end (cab) power bogies; intermediates unpowered. Approximate split.

length_carunits.formula: every car the same length so every joint (L_prev - L_this)/2 is zero - see core/convoy.py and civia_465
length_carunits.note: NOT 'pak128 always uses 8'; it is that mixing lengths in one convoy opens the joints, and no pak128 train does it.

window_colour.source: display/simgraph16.cc display_day_lights[0] (colors.WINDOW_DARK) -> warm yellow at night

cost.source: a placeholder in cents. To be balanced against pak128's own 2004-2010 EMUs (tools/measure_pakset.py + running game) before release.

runningcost.source: a placeholder per km. Same status as cost.
